record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Gittith<WH01665>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> O LORD<WH03068> our Lord<WH0113>, how excellent<WH0117> <FI>is<Fi> thy name<WH08034> in all the earth<WH0776>! who hast set<WH05414><WTH8798> thy glory<WH01935> above the heavens<WH08064>.

Out of the mouth<WH06310> of babes<WH05768> and sucklings<WH03243><WTH8802> hast thou ordained<WH03245><WTH8765> strength<WH05797> because of thine enemies<WH06887><WTH8802>, that thou mightest still<WH07673><WTH8687> the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> and the avenger<WH05358><WTH8693>. <RF>ordained: Heb. founded<Rf><CM>
When I consider<WH07200><WTH8799> thy heavens<WH08064>, the work<WH04639> of thy fingers<WH0676>, the moon<WH03394> and the stars<WH03556>, which thou hast ordained<WH03559><WTH8790>;
What is man<WH0582>, that thou art mindful<WH02142><WTH8799> of him? and the son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, that thou visitest<WH06485><WTH8799> him?
For thou hast made him a little<WH04592> lower<WH02637><WTH8762> than the angels<WH0430>, and hast crowned<WH05849><WTH8762> him with glory<WH03519> and honour<WH01926>.
Thou madest him to have dominion<WH04910><WTH8686> over the works<WH04639> of thy hands<WH03027>; thou hast put<WH07896><WTH8804> all <FI>things<Fi> under his feet<WH07272>:
All sheep<WH06792> and oxen<WH0504>, yea, and the beasts<WH0929> of the field<WH07704>; <RF>All...: Heb. Flocks and oxen all of them<Rf>
The fowl<WH06833> of the air<WH08064>, and the fish<WH01709> of the sea<WH03220>, <FI>and whatsoever<Fi> passeth through<WH05674><WTH8802> the paths<WH0734> of the seas<WH03220>.
O LORD<WH03068> our Lord<WH0113>, how excellent<WH0117> <FI>is<Fi> thy name<WH08034> in all the earth<WH0776>!<CM>
